rising.label: The new guard — this year's star and Bibs

counters.label: At the counter — the tapas bars

standing.label: Standing up — one thing, done for decades

cut.vn-abac: Cap: the three-star lane holds Disfrutar (the 2024 world No. 1), Cocina Hermanos Torres (the kitchen in the room) and Lasarte (the city's first three stars). ABaC's own record calls it 'technical spectacle over ingredient': the fourth three-star teaches the least about the place.
cut.vn-moments: Cap: the two-star lane is Mont Bar, Aleia and Cinc Sentits; Moments was demoted to one star in November 2024, and its Ruscalleda lineage is the classical register Cinc Sentits already covers with the city's own produce.
cut.vn-via-veneto: Cap: the old-guard haute cuisine of 1967 is a fine room, but the dated-house lane is told by Can Culleretes (1786), 7 Portes (1836) and Els Quatre Gats (1897), which are the city's own story rather than Belle Époque France.
cut.vr-berbena: Rising cap: the lane is this year's news (Kamikaze's first star, Glug's and Oníric's 2026 Bibs); Berbena's Bib dates from 2020.
cut.vr-cruix: Rising cap: a value tasting menu in the Nova Esquerra; the lane already holds two Bib rooms at the same price.
cut.vr-direkte: Cut: an 18-seat surprise-menu counter; the Asian-Catalan register is told by Dos Palillos in the elBulli lane.
cut.vr-besta: Cut: in the MICHELIN selection without star or Bib, five years open; not this year's story and not the city's oldest.
cut.vr-la-mundana: Cut: a Bib vermutería; the vermut lane holds the dated bodegas the ritual comes from (El Xampanyet 1929, Quimet 1954, Morro Fi 2007).
cut.vr-11-nudos: Cut: by its own old record a view-and-terrace stop with no award; the rooftop cards under Boire & sortir do the view better.
cut.vr-sartoria-panatieri: Cut: a world-ranked pizzeria, but a one-venue 'other kitchens' lane is merged or cut (GOLD6 rule); it is the one cut a pizza lover may regret.
cut.vq-bar-canyi: Quick-plate cap: burgers are not this city's plate; the lane keeps the 2010 pioneer (Bacoa) and the 1970 tortilla room (Flash Flash).
cut.vq-la-royale: Same: an uptown burger in Sarrià.
cut.vq-musta-shawarma: Cut: a single 2018 Guía Repsol mention, corroborated nowhere (its own record says so).
cut.vn-cerveceria-catalana: Counter cap: Bar Cañete, Cal Pep and Quimet & Quimet; Cervecería Catalana is a high-turnover hall with no bookings, by its own record built for volume.
cut.vn-bar-marsella: Not a table (no kitchen): the absinthe room becomes a card under Boire & sortir, its proper home.
cut.vn-london-bar: Not a table (a cocktail room): it becomes a card under Boire & sortir.
cut.vc-casa-gispert: Not a table (a nut roastery shop): it becomes a card in the larder.
cut.vc-la-bombeta: Told once: the bomba is told by La Cova Fumada, where it was born; La Bombeta is the same plate a few streets away.
cut.vc-la-confiteria: Vermut cap; its 1912 confectioner's fittings are lovely, but the lane's three tell the ritual's three ages.
cut.vc-bodega-la-palma: Vermut cap: a 1935 barrel bodega in the Gothic, the same story Bar Bodega Quimet tells in Gràcia.
cut.vc-can-recasens: Cut: cured-meat boards by candlelight in Poblenou; the wine-room lane holds three that pour better.
cut.v16-mercat-de-la-boqueria: Not a table: the market is a card in the larder (told once).
cut.v17-mercat-de-sant-antoni: Not a table: the market is a card in the larder (told once).
cut.v18-codorn-u: Not in the city: Codorníu's cellars are told in the Penedès day-trip card under Autour.

dropped_cards.gastronomy:Álvaro Palacios / Clos Mogado: Priorat is told by the Priorat drink card; the estates are two hours away
dropped_cards.art:* (the other 7 art spaces): cap: the culture fold keeps MNAC, Miró, MACBA, CCCB and the Disseny Hub; Tàpies, Foto Colectania, La Virreina, Santa Mònica, Hangar, Fabra i Coats and Palo Alto are left out
dropped_cards.underground:* (elrow, Brunch Electronik,: Sónar and Brunch are dated events (the calendar); Nitsa is told with Sala Apolo; Sabor de Gràcia inside the rumba card; elrow and Macarena are the cap
